info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Payments Payments Void-v5-spec
info.description: The Void Payment Transactions API allows businesses to reverse or void payment transactions efficiently. This endpoint is essential for managing payment lifecycle events, ensuring that incorrect or unwanted transactions can be addressed swiftly. It primarily supports financial operations and is typically used by e-commerce platforms, payment processors, and customer service teams to maintain transaction accuracy. By utilizing this API, developers can enhance transaction management and improve user trust by ensuring that payment errors are promptly resolved.

delete.description: This operation allows you to void a payment transaction, effectively reversing the charge. It is typically used when a payment has been made in error or when the service is not to be rendered. Ensure you have the correct payment ID before proceeding.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for voiding a payment. Ensure that you include all required fields as specified in the schema.

200.description: The void operation completed successfully, and the payment transaction has been canceled.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operation to void a payment. The body should contain a string representation of the operation details.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.title: Void Payment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the void operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment that was voided.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the void operation.

state.description: The current state of the payment after the void operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the void operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation result.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidResponse_200.description: Response schema for the void payment operation. It includes the status of the operation and relevant details about the processing result.
